entities.summary: Elliot Benchetrit is a Moroccan former tennis player who represented Morocco since 1 January 2021, having previously represented France. His highest singles ranking was No. 198 on 10 February 2020, and his highest doubles ranking was No. 198 on 10 June 2019.
